summary: Three independent process cards implementing ascii85 encode/decode, nth-weekday date lookup, and single-table substitution cipher, each with its own test file.

processes.title: Ascii85 encode/decode (Adobe variant, no delimiters)
processes.scope: Owns ascii85.py and tests/test_ascii85.py only. Does not touch nthweekday.py, substitution.py, any existing file, or anything under team/.
processes.task:
Implement a new module ascii85.py (standard library only, no imports from other project modules) plus tests/test_ascii85.py. Only create these two new files; never modify any existing file.

ascii85_encode(data) -> str:
- data must be bytes; bytearray (and any non-bytes input) raises TypeError.
- No <~ ~> delimiters in output.
- Rules fixed: every group of 4 bytes is treated as a 32-bit big-endian integer and written as 5 base-85 characters (each char = one base-85 digit + 33, char range '!' through 'u').
- A group of exactly four 0x00 bytes outputs the single character 'z' (only for complete all-zero groups).
- A trailing group shorter than 4 bytes (n = 1, 2, 3 bytes) is first padded with 0x00 to 4 bytes for encoding, then only the first n + 1 characters are output.
- Empty input returns "".

ascii85_decode(s) -> bytes:
- s must be str; non-str inputs raise TypeError.
- The character 'z' is only allowed at group start (meaning four 0x00 bytes); 'z' inside a group raises ValueError.
- All other characters must be in '!' through 'u'; out-of-range characters (including whitespace — whitespace is NOT skipped) raise ValueError.
- Every 5 characters decode to 4 bytes; a group value greater than 0xFFFFFFFF (overflow group) raises ValueError.
- A trailing group of length m must be 2, 3, or 4 (padded to 5 characters with 'u', decoded, then take the first m - 1 bytes); a trailing group of exactly 1 character raises ValueError.
- Empty string returns b"".

Every acceptance point below must have a corresponding test case in tests/test_ascii85.py:
- ascii85_encode(b"") == ""
- ascii85_encode(b"\x00\x00\x00\x00") == "z"
- ascii85_encode(b"\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00") == "zz"
- ascii85_encode(b"Man ") == "9jqo^"
- ascii85_encode(b"Man sure") == "9jqo^F*2M7"
- ascii85_encode(b"ab") == "@:B"
- ascii85_encode(b"hello") == "BOu!rDZ"
- ascii85_encode(b"\xff\xff\xff\xff") == "s8W-!"
- ascii85_decode("") == b""
- ascii85_decode("z") == b"\x00\x00\x00\x00"
- ascii85_decode("9jqo^") == b"Man "
- ascii85_decode("9jqo^F*2M7") == b"Man sure"
- ascii85_decode("s8W-!") == b"\xff\xff\xff\xff"
- ascii85_decode("@:B") == b"ab"
- ValueError: ascii85_decode("uuuuu") (overflow group), ascii85_decode("!") (1-char tail group), ascii85_decode("v!!!!") (illegal char), ascii85_decode("!z!!!") ('z' inside group), ascii85_decode("9jqo^ ") (whitespace not skipped)
- TypeError: ascii85_encode("Man "), ascii85_encode(bytearray(b"Man ")), ascii85_decode(b"9jqo^"), ascii85_decode(None)

processes.title: nth weekday of a month (n-th or last)
processes.scope: Owns nthweekday.py and tests/test_nthweekday.py only. Does not touch ascii85.py, substitution.py, any existing file, or anything under team/.
processes.task:
Implement a new module nthweekday.py (standard library only, no imports from other project modules) plus tests/test_nthweekday.py. Only create these two new files; never modify any existing file.

nth_weekday(year, month, weekday, n) -> datetime.date:
- weekday is fixed: 0 = Monday, 1 = Tuesday, ..., 6 = Sunday (same as datetime.date.weekday()).
- n >= 1 means the n-th such weekday of the month; n = -1 means the last such weekday of the month; n may only be -1 or a positive number.
- All parameters must be int (bool rejected); non-int raises TypeError.
- month outside 1-12, weekday outside 0-6, or n == 0 or n < -1 raise ValueError.
- If the month has no n-th such weekday (e.g. a month with only 4 Mondays when taking the 5th) raise ValueError.

Every acceptance point below must have a corresponding test case in tests/test_nthweekday.py:
- nth_weekday(2026, 11, 0, 3) == date(2026, 11, 16) (3rd Monday of Nov 2026)
- nth_weekday(2026, 11, 0, -1) == date(2026, 11, 30) (last Monday)
- nth_weekday(2026, 11, 6, -1) == date(2026, 11, 29) (last Sunday)
- nth_weekday(2026, 11, 0, 5) == date(2026, 11, 30) (5th Monday exists)
- nth_weekday(2024, 2, 3, -1) == date(2024, 2, 29) (leap-year February last Thursday)
- nth_weekday(2026, 1, 4, 1) == date(2026, 1, 2) (1st Friday)
- nth_weekday(2026, 12, 2, 2) == date(2026, 12, 9) (2nd Wednesday)
- nth_weekday(2025, 6, 5, 4) == date(2025, 6, 28) (4th Saturday)
- ValueError: nth_weekday(2026, 2, 0, 5) (no 5th Monday), nth_weekday(2026, 11, 0, 0), nth_weekday(2026, 11, 0, -2), nth_weekday(2026, 13, 0, 1), nth_weekday(2026, 11, 7, 1)
- TypeError: nth_weekday(2026, 11, 0, 1.0), nth_weekday("2026", 11, 0, 1), nth_weekday(2026, 11, True, 1)

processes.title: Single-table substitution cipher (encrypt/decrypt)
processes.scope: Owns substitution.py and tests/test_substitution.py only. Does not touch ascii85.py, nthweekday.py, any existing file, or anything under team/.
processes.task:
Implement a new module substitution.py (standard library only, no imports from other project modules) plus tests/test_substitution.py. Only create these two new files; never modify any existing file.

sub_encrypt(text, key) and sub_decrypt(text, key):
- key must be a str (non-str raises TypeError); it is case-insensitive and normalized to uppercase before validation. Validation: length != 26, any character outside A-Z, or any duplicate letter raises ValueError.
- Mapping fixed: plaintext A maps to key[0], B to key[1], ..., Z to key[25] (0-based key index); decryption uses the inverse mapping.
- text must be str (non-str raises TypeError). Preprocessing matches the other cipher modules this round: convert to uppercase, keep only A-Z (all other characters dropped); empty string (or empty after preprocessing) returns "".

Every acceptance point below must have a corresponding test case in tests/test_substitution.py. For most, key = "QWERTYUIOPASDFGHJKLZXCVBNM":
- sub_encrypt("ABC", key) == "QWE"
- sub_encrypt("HELLO", key) == "ITSSG"
- sub_encrypt("Hello, World!", key) == "ITSSGVGKSR" (preprocessing)
- sub_encrypt("THEQUICKBROWNFOX", key) == "ZITJXOEAWKGVFYGB"
- sub_encrypt("", key) == ""
- sub_encrypt("abc", "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm") == "QWE" (lowercase key normalized)
- sub_decrypt("ITSSG", key) == "HELLO"
- sub_decrypt("ITSSGVGKSR", key) == "HELLOWORLD"
- With key2 = "ZYXWVUTSRQPONMLKJIHGFEDCBA": sub_encrypt("ABC", key2) == "ZYX" and sub_decrypt("ZYX", key2) == "ABC"
- Roundtrip: sub_decrypt(sub_encrypt(t, key), key) == t for t in "HELLOWORLD", "THEQUICKBROWNFOXJUMPSOVERTHELAZYDOG", "A", "ZZZZ"
- ValueError: sub_encrypt("ABC", "QWERTYUIOPASDFGHJKLZXCVBN") (length 25), sub_encrypt("ABC", "QWERTYUIOPASDFGHJKLZXCVBNA") (duplicate letter), sub_encrypt("ABC", "QWERTYUIOPASDFGHJKLZXCVBN1") (non-letter)
- TypeError: sub_encrypt("ABC", None), sub_encrypt(123, key), sub_decrypt(None, key)
